mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spin_records (user_id, segment_key, label, icon, type, points_delta, points_after, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{segmentKey}, #{label}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{pointsDelta}, #{pointsAfter}, #{createdAt})
